name: Ada Lovelace
description: Built the first compiler-style translation of Bernoulli numbers into machine operations; led a team of six engineers on numerical methods; published two papers on program notation.

name: Grace Hopper
description: Designed the first English-like data processing language and its compiler; maintained large production systems; mentored junior programmers for a decade.

name: Alan Turing
description: Formal models of computation and early machine intelligence; worked on cryptanalysis hardware; no production software experience listed.
